findings: The book writes 'Acidified potassium chromate(VI), K2Cr2O7'; it is potassium dichromate(VI).
The Keep in Mind box says the reduction requires 'hydrogen (H-) ions'; it is H+ ions.
The breathalyser box says the oxidation of ethanol 'requires electrons'; oxidation releases electrons, which give the measured current.
The label 'ethonal' under ethanol is corrected. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
